title: 第9章 枫叶林第10章 御剑术

第9章 枫叶林
来到新手村，村长老爷爷满脸微笑，招呼着过往的玩家，见到刘烨过来，兴奋道：“小兄弟，你真是我们新手村的救星啊！”
“村长爷爷太见外了，这都是应该的，不管什么忙我都乐意去帮的！”刘烨撇嘴一笑。
“如今像你这样乐于助人的年轻人越来越少了，按照之前约定好的，这是给你的奖励！”
“叮！”——
系统提示：完成【击杀大黑熊】任务，奖励经验50000点，魅力值永久+1，获得击杀大黑熊后续任务【寻找拜亚帝国】……
系统提示：等级提升至10级，获得1点自由属性，可通过新手村村长传送到华夏区十大次级主城！
听到这一连串的奖励，刘烨心中那个激动啊！这个任务不仅把自己送到了10级，而且还奖励1点魅力属性，要知道，在封神世界中，魅力属性和幸运属性都是相当重要的存在。
往往能够决定玩家触发特殊任务或者隐藏任务的几率，而幸运还会影响到玩家杀怪的爆率，都是不可多得的属性！
“年轻人，既然你能够击杀大黑熊，那就说明你有着不俗的实力，不瞒你说，我们新手村的村名全都是拜亚帝国的后裔，希望小兄弟能够帮我们找到祖国的遗址！”村长满脸沧桑的说道。
“村长放心，我一定不会让您失望的！”刘烨义正言辞的说着，心中早已经乐开了花，没想到这个击杀大黑熊的任务还有后续，而且看样子还不是一般的任务。
村长满意的点头，说道：“年轻人，你现在已经足够强大了，如果有机会前往落日城的话，把这封信交给我的好朋友路德，他是落日城圣殿骑士团团长，应该可以帮助你寻找拜亚帝国！”
“村长放心就是，为了奖励…哦不，是为了世界和平，晚辈一定会帮您找到祖国的遗址！”刘烨一边笑着，一边从村长的手里接过介绍信：
【村长的信笺】：村长写给路德的介绍信，可以在落日城圣殿骑士团得到调查拜亚帝国灭亡的线索和圣殿骑士团的帮助……
“你是我所见过最勇敢的战士，愿剑客之路与你同在，这个徽章可以带给你好运！”
刘烨一愣，急忙号：
【拜亚足迹－1级】（稀有称号）
佩戴要求：寻找拜亚帝国任务
基础属性：力量+5、智力+5
附加属性：攻速+1

（封神中的称号等级分为：普通称号、高级称号、精英称号、稀有称号，特殊称号。）
刘烨哑然，没想到竟然获得了稀有称号，而且附加属性竟然是攻速+1，这是多少玩家梦寐以求的属性啊？
“多谢村长，您放心吧！我一定不会让您失望的，现在就送我前往落日城吧！”刘烨目光坚定的说道。
“去吧年轻人，我看好你！落日城因你而美丽！”村长满意的点点头，双臂自然张开，凝聚出一道道摧残的白光将跟班二号传送到了落日城。
刘烨只感觉自己眼前一花，睁开眼睛的时候，已经来到了华夏区十大次级主城之一的落日城，好在这个寻找拜亚帝国的任务也是在落日城，不然自己还得好好麻烦一阵子！
繁荣的落日城内，玩家川流不息，这个时段，主流玩家大多已经走出了新手村，这些人的疯狂。
还是自己比较低调，经过前世的体验，刘烨清楚的知道，有时候受人关注也是一种麻烦，像自己这样看上去普普通通，其实穿着一身紫装的玩家多自在？
上，跟班二号的属性有点想要逆天的趋势：
ID：跟班二号
职业：九转剑仙
等级：10
声望：97
称号：【拜亚足迹－1级】
生命值：600
魔法值：460
物理攻击：105－121
魔法攻击：48
物防：69
魔防：29
速度：19

攻速：5
命中：37
闪避：33
暴击率：3%
魅力：1
幸运：0
仔细的欣赏一番，刘烨心中得意万分，隐藏职业的优势果然很明显，现阶段的本尊和自己已经拉不小的开差距，真的很想见到自己的本尊，但是刘烨心中却有点害怕。
看着四周来来往往的玩家，刘烨不再多想，凭借自己前世的记忆，很快便找到了落日城的剑客导师－塔伦，“导师，我是来就职的！”
塔伦看到跟班二号，睿智的眼眸中射出一道奇异的光芒，惊呼着说道：“竟然是九世剑修，没想到我们落日城竟然出现了传说中的九世剑修，果然和正常人不一样！”
于是乎，在刘烨错愕的目光下，导师NPC塔伦仔细的打量着跟班二号，就好像在欣赏美女的**一般，口中噌噌称奇。
“导师，我是来就职的，您知不知道我的导师在哪里？”刘烨尴尬的问道。
只见塔伦得意一笑，说道：“这你可算是找对人了，十大皇城中，也只有我塔伦知道九世剑修的引导人在哪里！”
“真的吗？那真是太好了！”刘烨激动道。
“你去云香酒馆看看，那边的门口经常躺着一名酒鬼，只要你给他买一瓶酒，他就会让你就职了！”塔伦眼睛一转，道：“不过在这之前，你可以在我这里学习剑客技能，看在你是九世剑修的份上，我给你打八折怎么样？”
刘烨愕然，不过剑客的基础技能自己也是要学习的，技能越多越好嘛！
是自己前世很熟练的剑客技能，每个技能的学习费用5金币，八折之后自己一共花费了8金币。
自己的技能栏里立刻多出了两个新技能：
【剑气斩】（攻击技能）
等级：1
消耗：56点魔法值

效果：凝聚一道蓝色剑气，在身前挥出强有力的一剑，造成120%物理伤害+100%魔法伤害。
冷却：10秒
释放距离：5米
【冲锋】（限制技能）
等级：1
消耗：60点魔法值
效果：激发剑客潜能，瞬间爆发出来，对前方单体目标发出强有力的冲撞，造成70%物理伤害，使目标陷入2秒眩晕状态。
冷却：25秒
释放距离：8米
除此之外，技能怒斩在昨夜的组队刷怪中已经升到了10级，技能效果变成150%物理伤害+人物等级*5固定伤害，冷却时间也减少到了10秒。
这些技能自己都用得上，特别是冲锋，作为剑客的招牌技能之一，那2秒的眩晕可以说是至关重要的！
就在刘烨准备前往云香酒馆寻找导师的时候，一条好友消息弹了出来，不用看，绝对是自己的二小姐，因为自己的好友列表里只有二小姐一个人。
“二号，我就职了！快把你的金币全都拿过来，我要学技能！”
“额…，二小姐是不是屁股痒痒了？”
“不行，我是大姐大，你在哪？我要学技能！”二小姐蛮不讲理的回复道。
刘烨无奈的摇摇头，你快点过来，我在落日城南门等你！”
“太好了，马上就到！”二小姐很显然也在落日城，不到五分钟的时间就出现在了刘烨面前。
只见一名叫做蝶恋花的极品小萝莉雀跃着向自己这边跑过来，精致的皮甲下，身材微微凸起，曲线迷人，一路跑过来吸引了不少人的目光，“二号，10个金币，快点！”
“知道了！”刘烨无奈的撇撇嘴，自从收服二小姐以后，刘烨对她的印象还不错，除了非常捣蛋之外其他一切还好，“刚好得到一本不错的技能书，一并给你了！”
刘烨向蝶恋花发出交易申请，然后将10个金币和【落花流】技能书交易过去。

二小姐看到技能书，急忙点击使用，生怕刘烨反悔一样，“嘿嘿…，今天表现不错，以后给你加工资！”
“额，”刘烨无语，好奇的凑过去问道：“让我看看技能效果？”
二小姐也不吝啬，豪爽的将技能栏展示给刘烨，细看之下，刘烨都有些后悔了，落花流这个技能简直太牛逼了，纯正的限制技能，虽然没有丝毫的攻击力，但却拥有5秒的眩晕效果。
5秒啊！有这5秒的时间足够挂掉自己很多次了！
“为什么不是剑客技能啊？”刘烨痛苦的说道。
只见二小姐小脸得意，忽然间收起了大姐大的姿态，认真的盯着刘烨说道：“二号，你是我见过最好的跟班！”
“那是！”刘烨得意的撇撇嘴。
“那……你给我做一辈子的跟班好不好？我以后把零花钱都给你当工资，好不好？”说到这里，二小姐的脸上浮现出一丝羞红。
闻言，刘烨愣住了，怪异看向眼前这位羞怯的少女，这还是自己认识的那个恶霸二小姐吗？
“哼，就知道你不答应！相当本小姐跟班的人多了去了！”二小姐很快恢复了本性，愤恨的叉着腰说道。
“是吗？”刘烨目光玩味的问道。
“当然！”二小姐得意的仰起小脑袋，似乎想起了某些事情，娇呼一声，说道：“对了，我拉你进公会吧！本小姐现在可是公会的圣女！”
二小姐刚刚说完，刘烨这边就收到了一条公会邀请：好友（蝶恋花）邀请您加入公会【枫叶林】，是否同意？
刘烨想了想，自己现在怎么说也是叶家的卖身跟班，加入叶家的公会也是应该的，于是便点击了确认。
人，此时的公会列表里连一半人都不到，很大一部分都是叶家内部的玩家，大小姐的神话轩轩以副会长的职位挂在成员列表的最上层！
除此之外，月落和乌啼两位高手也在其中，至于会长的职位，自然是月下独赏，也就是我们伟大的女强人叶夫人了。
作为公会的新人，刘烨很懂规矩，热情的在公会频里发言说道：“大家好，新人报道，求罩！”
令刘烨无奈的是，自己这一条消息很快被其他人的消息给淹没了，大小姐神话轩轩似乎在筹备推BOSS的事情，根本没人注意刘烨的发言。
身为副会长的大小姐自然收到了跟班二号的入会的提示，想到那个色胆包天的下人，心中涌出阵阵厌恶，“雨蝶，你怎么把这小子也拉进来了！”

Chapter 9 Maple Leaf Forest
Arriving at Novice Village, the village elder greeted the passing players with a smile on his face. Seeing Liu Ye coming, he said excitedly: "Little brother, you are really the savior of our Novice Village!"
"The village chief is too outspoken. This is what he should do. I will be happy to help no matter what you do!" Liu Ye curled his lips and smiled.
"There are fewer and fewer young people like you who are willing to help others. As agreed before, this is a reward for you!"
"Ding!"——
System prompt: Complete the mission [Kill the Big Black Bear], and you will be rewarded with 50,000 experience points, permanent charm value +1, and get the follow-up mission [Searching for the Baia Empire] after killing the big black bear...
System prompt: Upgrade your level to level 10, gain 1 point of free attributes, and be able to teleport to the top ten secondary main cities in Huaxia District through the village chief of Novice Village!
Hearing this series of rewards, Liu Ye was so excited! This task not only sent you to level 10, but also rewarded you with 1 point of charm attribute. You must know that in the world of gods, charm attributes and luck attributes are both very important.
It can often determine the player's chances of triggering special tasks or hidden tasks, and luck can also affect the player's chance of killing monsters. These are all rare attributes!
"Young man, since you can kill the big black bear, it means that you have great strength. To be honest, the names of our novice villages are all descendants of the Baia Empire. I hope that my little brother can help us find the ruins of our motherland!" the village chief said with a face full of vicissitudes of life.
"Don't worry, village chief, I won't let you down!" Liu Ye said righteously, already feeling happy in his heart. He didn't expect that there would be a follow-up to the mission of killing the big black bear, and it seemed that it was not an ordinary mission.
The village chief nodded with satisfaction and said: "Young man, you are strong enough now. If you have the opportunity to go to Sunset City, give this letter to my good friend Luther. He is the leader of the Templar Knights of Sunset City. He should be able to help you find the Baiya Empire!"
"Don't worry, village chief. For the sake of reward...oh no, for world peace, I will definitely help you find the ruins of your motherland!" Liu Ye smiled and took the letter of introduction from the village chief:
[Village Chief’s Letter]: The letter of introduction written by the village chief to Luther can be used by the Knights Templar of Sunset City to get clues about the demise of the Baia Empire and the help of the Knights Templar...
"You are the bravest warrior I have ever seen. May the swordsman's journey be with you. This badge can bring you good luck!"
Liu Ye was stunned and shouted hurriedly:
[Baia Footsteps - Level 1] (rare title)
Wearing requirements: Search for the Baia Empire mission
Basic attributes: Strength +5, Intelligence +5
Additional attributes: Attack speed +1
(The title levels in Fengshen are divided into: ordinary titles, advanced titles, elite titles, rare titles, and special titles.)
Liu Ye was dumbfounded. He didn't expect to get the rare title, and the additional attribute was attack speed +1. This is an attribute that many players dream of?
"Thank you, village chief. Don't worry! I won't let you down. Send me to Sunset City now!" Liu Ye said with firm eyes.
"Go, young man, I'm optimistic about you! Sunset City is beautiful because of you!" The village chief nodded with satisfaction, opened his arms naturally, and condensed a stream of destructive white light to teleport Follower No. 2 to Sunset City.
Liu Ye only felt that his eyes were blurred. When he opened his eyes, he had already arrived at Sunset City, one of the ten major secondary cities in the Huaxia District. Fortunately, the mission of finding the Baiya Empire was also in Sunset City, otherwise he would have been in trouble for a while!
In the prosperous Sunset City, there is an endless stream of players. At this time, most of the mainstream players have left the Novice Village. These people are crazy.
He is still relatively low-key. After the experience in his previous life, Liu Ye clearly knows that sometimes it is troublesome to be noticed by others. Looking at it like thisIt looks ordinary, but how comfortable are the players wearing purple clothes?
On the other hand, the attributes of Follower No. 2 are somewhat contrary to the trend:
ID: Follower No. 2
Occupation: Nine-turn Sword Immortal
Level: 10
Reputation: 97
Title: [Baia Footsteps-Level 1]
HP: 600
Magic value: 460
Physical attack: 105-121
Magic Attack: 48
Physical defense: 69
Magic Defense: 29
Speed: 19
Attack speed: 5
Hits: 37
Dodge: 33
Critical hit rate: 3%
Charisma: 1
Lucky: 0
After carefully admiring it, Liu Ye felt very proud. The advantage of hiding his profession was indeed obvious. At this stage, the gap between him and his true self had widened considerably. He really wanted to see his true self, but Liu Ye was a little scared.
Looking at the players coming and going around, Liu Ye stopped thinking about it. With the memory of his previous life, he quickly found the swordsman instructor of Sunset City, Talen. "Instructor, I am here to take up a job!"
When Tarun saw Follower No. 2, a strange light shot out from his wise eyes, and he exclaimed: "It turned out to be the Ninth Generation Sword Cultivator. I didn't expect that the legendary Ninth Generation Sword Cultivator would appear in our Sunset City. He is really different from normal people!"
Ever since, under Liu Ye's astonished gaze, the mentor NPC Talen looked at Follower No. 2 carefully, as if he was admiring the beauty's vagina, and he was amazed.
"Mentor, I'm here to take a job. Do you know where my mentor is?" Liu Ye asked awkwardly.
Talen smiled proudly and said, "You have found the right person. Among the ten imperial cities, I am the only one who knows where the leader of the Ninth Sword Cultivator is!"
"Really? That's great!" Liu Ye said excitedly.
"Go to Yunxiang Tavern. There is always a drunkard lying at the door. As long as you buy him a bottle of wine, he will let you take up the job!" Talon rolled his eyes and said: "But before that, you can learn swordsman skills from me. Since you are a ninth-generation swordsman, how about I give you a 20% discount?"
Liu Ye was stunned, but he also had to learn the basic skills of a swordsman. The more skills, the better!
It was a swordsman skill that I was very proficient in in my previous life. Each skill cost 5 gold coins to learn. After the 20% discount, I spent a total of 8 gold coins.
Two new skills immediately appeared in his skill bar:
[Sword Qi Slash] (attack skill)
Level: 1
Cost: 56 magic points
Effect: Condensing a blue sword energy, swinging a powerful sword in front of you, causing 120% physical damage + 100% magic damage.
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Release distance: 5 meters
[Charge] (limited skill)
Level: 1
Cost: 60 magic points
Effect: Stimulates the potential of the swordsman, bursts out instantly, and launches a powerful collision with a single target in front, causing 70% physical damage and causing the target to fall into a dazed state for 2 seconds.
Cooldown: 25 seconds
Release distance: 8 meters
In addition, the skill Furious Slash has been upgraded to level 10 during the team spawning last night. The skill effect becomes 150% physical damage + character level * 5 fixed damage, and the cooldown time is also reduced to 10 seconds.
You can use these skills yourself, especially charge. As one of the swordsman's signature skills, the 2-second stun can be said to be crucial!
Just when Liu Ye was about to go to Yunxiang Tavern to find a mentor, a friend message popped up. No need to look at it, it was definitely his second lady, because there was only the second lady in his friend list.
"No. 2, I'm in office! Get all your gold coins quickly, I want to learn skills!"
"Um...is the second lady's butt itchy?"
"No, I'm the eldest sister. Where are you? I want to learn skills!" the second young lady replied unreasonably.
Liu Ye shook his head helplessly. Come here quickly. I'll wait for you at the south gate of Sunset City.! "
“Great, be there soon! "The second young lady was obviously also in Sunset City, and she appeared in front of Liu Ye in less than five minutes.
I saw a top-notch little loli named Die Lianhua running towards me happily. Under her exquisite leather armor, her figure was slightly raised and her curves were charming. She attracted many people's attention as she ran over, "No. 2, 10 gold coins, hurry up!" "
"knew! "Liu Ye curled his lips helplessly. Since conquering the second lady, Liu Ye had a good impression of her. Apart from being very naughty, everything else was good. "I just got a good skill book, so I'll give it to you! "
Liu Ye sent a transaction request to Die Lianhua, and then traded 10 gold coins and the [Luohua Liu] skill book.
The second lady saw the skill book and hurriedly clicked to use it, fearing that Liu Ye would regret it, "Hey..., you did a good job today, I will give you a salary increase in the future!" "
"Um," Liu Ye was speechless and curiously leaned over and asked, "Let me see the effect of the skill? "
The second lady was not stingy and showed the skill bar to Liu Ye boldly. After a closer look, Liu Ye regretted it. The skill Luohualiu was simply too awesome. It was a pure limiting skill. Although it had no attack power at all, it had a 5-second stun effect.
5 seconds! These 5 seconds are enough to kill yourself many times!
"Why isn't it a swordsman skill? Liu Ye said painfully.
I saw the smug face of the second young lady. She suddenly put away her elder sister's attitude, stared at Liu Ye seriously and said: "No. 2, you are the best follower I have ever seen! "
"That's right! "Liu Ye curled his lips proudly.
"Then...can you be my follower for the rest of your life? I will give you all my pocket money as salary from now on, okay? "Speaking of this, a hint of blush appeared on the second lady's face.
Hearing this, Liu Ye was stunned and looked at the shy girl in front of him strangely. Is this still the bully second lady he knew?
"Humph, I knew you wouldn't agree! There are quite a lot of people following me! "The second young lady quickly returned to her true nature and said with her hands on her hips angrily.
"Really? Liu Ye asked with a playful look.
"Of course! The second young lady raised her little head proudly, as if she had remembered something, and she let out a sweet cry and said, "By the way, I'll drag you into the guild!" This young lady is now the saint of the guild! "
Just as the second lady finished speaking, Liu Ye received a guild invitation: Your friend (Die Lianhua) invites you to join the guild [Maple Leaf Forest], do you agree?
Liu Ye thought for a while. He was now a prostitute of the Ye family, so he should join the Ye family's guild, so he clicked to confirm.
There are less than half of the people in the guild list at this time, and a large part of them are players within the Ye family. The eldest lady, Shinhwa Xuanxuan, is at the top of the member list with the position of vice president!
In addition, two masters, Yue Luo and Wu Ti, are also among them. As for the position of president, it is naturally the only one awarded by Yue Xia, that is, our great strong woman Mrs. Ye.
As a newcomer to the guild, Liu Ye knew the rules very well and spoke enthusiastically on the guild channel: "Hello everyone, newbie report, please help! "
To Liu Ye's helplessness, his message was quickly drowned out by other people's messages. The eldest lady, Shinhwa Xuanxuan, seemed to be preparing to promote BOSS, and no one paid any attention to Liu Ye's speech.
As the vice-president, the eldest lady naturally received the reminder from Follower No. 2 to join the club. Thinking of that cowardly servant, she felt disgust in her heart, "Yu Die, why did you bring this kid in? "
